ITEM_ENHANCED: Boss gear: two bonus attributes added
ITEM_BOSS_BONUS_EXPLAIN: Boss-enhanced: your first copy of this item from a boss added two bonus attributes. Later boss copies count as normal copies. Bonus attributes reset at Prestige; merge levels stay.
ITEM_BOSS_BONUS_HINT: The first copy of this item you get from a boss adds two bonus attributes (once per run).
